# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Check for chained `dig` calls that can be collapsed into a single `dig`.
      #
      # @safety
      #   This cop is unsafe because it cannot be guaranteed that the receiver
      #   is an `Enumerable` or does not have a nonstandard implementation
      #   of `dig`.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   x.dig(:foo).dig(:bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz)
      #
      #   # good
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      #
      #   # good - `dig`s cannot be combined
      #   x.dig(:foo).bar.dig(:baz)
      #
      class DigChain < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include RangeHelp
        include CommentsHelp
        include DigHelp

        MSG = 'Use `%<replacement>s` instead of chaining.'
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[dig].freeze
        BYTE_ORDER_MARK = 0xfeff
        BLANK_SPACE_PATTERN = /\A[ \t]+\z/.freeze
        FORWARDING_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[forwarded_args forwarded_restarg forwarded_kwrestarg].freeze
        LITERAL_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[sym str int float rational complex nil true false].freeze
        VARIABLE_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[lvar ivar cvar gvar nth_ref back_ref].freeze

        def on_send(node)
          return if ignored_node?(node)
          return unless node.loc.dot
          return unless dig?(node)

          remember_chain_root(node)
          remember_navigation_context(node)

          range, arguments = inspect_chain(node)
          return if invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          return unless range

          register_offense(node, range, arguments)
        end
        alias on_csend on_send

        def self.build_buffer_range(buffer, start_pos, end_pos)
          Parser::Source::Range.new(
            buffer,
            normalize_buffer_index(buffer, start_pos),
            normalize_buffer_index(buffer, end_pos)
          )
        end

        def self.normalize_buffer_index(_buffer, position)
          position
        end

        def self.build_source_range(source_buffer, line_number, column, length = 1)
          if column.is_a?(Range)
            column_index = column.begin
            length = column.size
          else
            column_index = column
          end

          line_begin_pos = if line_number.zero?
                             0
                           else
                             source_buffer.line_range(line_number).begin_pos
                           end
          begin_pos = line_begin_pos + column_index
          end_pos = begin_pos + length
          Parser::Source::Range.new(source_buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def self.expand_range_with_comma(buffer, range, side = :both)
          src = buffer.source
          go_left, go_right = side_directions(side)
          begin_pos = range.begin_pos
          end_pos = range.end_pos
          begin_pos = shift_pos_if(src, begin_pos, -1, go_left, /,/)
          end_pos = shift_pos_if(src, end_pos, 1, go_right, /,/)
          Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def self.expand_range_with_space(buffer, range, side, newlines, whitespace, continuations)
          src = buffer.source
          go_left, go_right = side_directions(side)
          begin_pos = range.begin_pos
          begin_pos = scan_space_boundary(src, begin_pos, -1, continuations, newlines, whitespace) if go_left
          end_pos = range.end_pos
          end_pos = scan_space_boundary(src, end_pos, 1, continuations, newlines, whitespace) if go_right
          Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def self.expand_range_to_whole_lines(buffer, range, include_final_newline)
          last_line = buffer.source_line(range.last_line)
          end_offset = last_line.length - range.last_column
          end_offset += 1 if include_final_newline
          range.adjust(begin_pos: -range.column, end_pos: end_offset).intersect(buffer.source_range)
        end

        def self.editor_column(range, raw_source)
          if range.line == 1 && raw_source.codepoints.first == BYTE_ORDER_MARK
            range.column - 1
          else
            range.column
          end
        end

        def self.merge_ranges(range1, range2)
          merged_begin = [range1.begin_pos, range2.begin_pos].min
          merged_end = [range1.end_pos, range2.end_pos].max
          range1.with(begin_pos: merged_begin, end_pos: merged_end)
        end

        def self.range_covering_comments(processed_source, node)
          related = processed_source.ast_with_comments[node]
          ranges = [node.source_range]
          related.each { |comment| ranges << comment.source_range }
          ranges.reduce { |result, range| merge_ranges(result, range) }
        end

        def self.blank_space_range_between(buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
          return if end_pos <= begin_pos

          range = Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
          return unless range.source.match?(BLANK_SPACE_PATTERN)

          range
        end

        def self.side_directions(side)
          if side == :both
            [true, true]
          else
            [side == :left, side == :right]
          end
        end

        def self.scan_space_boundary(src, pos, increment, continuations, newlines, whitespace)
          pos = shift_pos_if(src, pos, increment, true, /[ \t]/)
          pos = shift_pos_str(src, pos, increment, continuations, "\\\n")
          pos = shift_pos_if(src, pos, increment, newlines, /\n/)
          shift_pos_if(src, pos, increment, whitespace, /\s/)
        end

        def self.shift_pos_if(src, pos, step, condition, regexp)
          offset = step == -1 ? -1 : 0
          pos += step while condition && regexp.match?(src[pos + offset])
          pos.negative? ? 0 : pos
        end

        def self.shift_pos_str(src, pos, step, condition, needle)
          size = needle.length
          offset = step == -1 ? -size : 0
          pos += size * step while condition && src[pos + offset, size] == needle
          pos.negative? ? 0 : pos
        end

        def self.source_range_with_leading_comment(processed_source, node)
          begin_pos = begin_pos_with_leading_comment(processed_source, node)
          end_pos = end_position_for_node(processed_source, node)
          Parser::Source::Range.new(processed_source.buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def self.each_comment_for_node(processed_source, node)
          start_line = node.source_range.line
          end_line = find_end_line_for(node)
          processed_source.each_comment_in_lines(start_line...end_line)
        end

        def self.node_contains_comments?(processed_source, node)
          each_comment_for_node(processed_source, node).any?
        end

        def self.comments_disable_cop?(processed_source, node, cop_name)
          disabled_ranges = processed_source.disabled_line_ranges[cop_name]
          return false unless disabled_ranges

          node_range = node.source_range.line...find_end_line_for(node)
          disabled_ranges.any? do |disable_range|
            disable_range.cover?(node_range) || node_range.cover?(disable_range)
          end
        end

        def self.end_position_for_node(processed_source, node)
          buffer = processed_source.buffer
          end_line = buffer.line_for_position(node.source_range.end_pos)
          buffer.line_range(end_line).end_pos
        end

RSpec.describe RuboCop::Cop::Style::DigChain, :config do
  it 'does not register an offense for unchained `dig` without a receiver' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      dig
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for `X::dig`' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      X::dig(:foo, :bar)
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for dig chained to something else' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig(:foo).bar
      x.bar.dig(:foo)
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense when the chain is broken up' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig(:foo).first.dig(:bar)
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for dig without arguments' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for chained dig without arguments' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig
      x.dig.dig(:foo, :bar)
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for a hash' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig({ foo: 1, bar: 2 }).dig({ baz: 3, quux: 4 })
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for kwargs' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig(foo: 1, bar: 2).dig(baz: 3, quux: 4)
    RUBY
  end

  context 'with chained `dig` calls' do

        x.y.z.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      RUBY
    end

    it 'registers an offense and corrects with multiple values' do

        x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig(:baz, :quux)

      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
      RUBY
    end

    it 'registers an offense and corrects with safe navigation' do
      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz, :quux)

      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
      RUBY
    end

      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        x&.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz, :quux)

      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x&.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
      RUBY
    end

    it 'registers an offense and corrects without a receiver' do

        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Use `dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)` instead of chaining.
      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
      RUBY
    end

      RUBY
